requiredEnvironment.LITHE_TEST_MAVEN_PLUGIN_ARCHIVE: maven-build-<version>-darwin.zip to install, for example dist/maven-build-0.0.1-darwin.zip
requiredEnvironment.LITHE_PLUGIN_MAVEN_DIR: directory holding the plugin.json and templates; defaults to this repository's
requiredEnvironment.LITHE_TEST_JAVA_PLUGIN_ARCHIVE: Lithe-Java-Support-<version>-darwin-<arch>.zip from Lithe-IDEA/lithe-plugin-java releases; its java tool launches the run and its java adapter debugs it
